name: Freeze and shatter
summary: A cold weapon or power does little or no damage by itself. Held on a target, it slows it more and more, and once enough cold has built up the target freezes solid: it can't move, fire or use abilities, and a frozen building stops working. A frozen target is brittle, so the next hits do heavy bonus damage or break it outright (the shatter); some games keep that bonus for a dedicated finisher. If nobody follows up, the ice thaws by itself, and the build-up fades once the beam stops. Big targets take longer to freeze, and several freezers stack. It is a setup tool: the freezer holds a target and a teammate cashes it in, which gives the victim a window to escape and their team a window to rescue.
counterplay: Break the build-up: leave the beam's reach or its line of sight before the freeze lands; the cold fades once the beam stops.
Kill or chase off the freezer first: its beam does little damage, and the Red Alert 3 Cryocopter can't even aim at aircraft.
Bring fliers or long-range guns against freezers that only reach the ground or have a short beam.
Stay near your team: a frozen unit beside its allies can be shielded or thawed, while a frozen loner is free damage.
Thaw or protect frozen allies: in Red Alert 3 the Iron Curtain's invulnerability ends a freeze at once, and repair keeps working on frozen units.
Step out of area freezes: a storm such as Overwatch's Blizzard needs a few seconds to freeze whoever stays inside it.
Lead with big targets: heavy vehicles take much longer to freeze than soldiers, which keeps the freezer exposed for longer.
Spread out against area freezes and shatter bursts, so one combo can't catch the whole team.

other_examples.note: Infantry whose cryo cannon freezes everything in a cone ahead of them; like the Cryocopter's beam, the cold builds up against each target's full health and fades if it stops. Frozen targets break under almost any hit, and the soldier's Boost Kick jump can land on them to shatter them. Its blasts can catch friendly units, and it never ranks up. Loaded into a Multigunner IFV or turret, it turns the mount into a single cryobeam that also reaches aircraft, which fall and break when frozen.

A side-wide power: a satellite ray freezes the ground units in a target area so that they can be shattered. Each upgrade widens it and lets it freeze bigger units and then buildings, from small defences up to most structures. It never affects aircraft, superweapons or a few special structures.

sources.title: Top Secret Protocol, Command & Conquer Wiki

other_examples.note: Cryo Bomb locks every unit and building in an area in ice, so nothing there can move or act. Seismic Blast is a charge that does little to unfrozen targets but shatters frozen ones for large damage, and Cryotech Advances adds a chilling effect to some shells, turrets and troopers. The wiki's advice is to focus fire on frozen targets and to pair her freezes with allies' heavy damage powers, which makes her a support leader who is strongest in team games.

For many years a passive that raised the mage's chance of critical strikes against frozen targets, meaning enemies held in place by frost effects such as Frost Nova. Patch 12.0 reworked it into a build-up: Frostbolt and Flurry stack a freezing debuff, and Ice Lance spends those stacks for extra frost damage.

other_examples.unit: Ancient Apparition's Cold Feet and Ice Blast
other_examples.note: Cold Feet hexes an enemy with damage over time and, after a few seconds, freezes it in place unless it has moved far enough from where the hex landed, so the escape is built in. Ice Blast frostbites everything in a marked area so it can't heal, and shatters any frostbitten enemy whose health falls below a threshold: an execute rather than a hold.

shooter_analogues.note: In the first game her short-range frost spray slowed a target more and more until it froze for a moment; her two fire modes form a combo, a slow followed by an icicle to the head, and her Blizzard ultimate freezes enemies who stay inside the storm. Overwatch 2's beta took the freeze off her primary fire. A June 2023 patch added a build-up slow that her icicle could detonate for extra damage, which the developers described as bringing back the old feel without a full freeze; in October 2023 they removed it again, finding that it piled crowd control on her opponents while making her weaker, and her spray went back to a slow that applies at once. A later optional perk restores a brief freeze after a stream of hits, needing many more hits against tanks.

Stasis abilities stack a slow on targets; enough stacks freeze them in place, and further damage on a frozen target shatters it, hurting it and everything around it. Some abilities exist mainly to shatter, such as a slide or a dive into frozen targets, and one aspect sends freezing seekers out from each shattered target. Its keyword text treats players more gently than other targets: a new Stasis crystal freezes nearby combatants but only slows nearby players.

player_translation.summary: A T2 support or disabler with a short cold beam that does almost no damage. Held on an enemy it fills a frost meter that slows them more and more; when it fills, they freeze for a short, fixed moment, and the first heavy hit on the ice shatters it for bonus damage and ends the freeze. The victim sees the meter coming and can break it, a frozen player can thaw faster or be rescued, and nobody can be frozen again straight away.
as_user: You buy a fragile, fast support, such as a helicopter in the Cryocopter's spirit or a cryo trooper. Your gun is a cold beam: hold it on a target to fill its frost meter. You deal almost no damage; your job is to freeze the right target at the right moment.
Big targets fill slowly and soldiers quickly, so freezing a tank means holding the beam for a while in the open. Several freezers on one target fill it faster.
A frozen target is helpless for a moment and brittle: ping it so a teammate with a heavy weapon shatters it. If nobody follows up it thaws, and the setup is wasted.
After a freeze the target is briefly immune, so switch targets instead of locking one player down again and again.
Pick fights near your teammates, and keep away from anti-air and long guns that kill you before your beam lands.
as_target: You see frost creeping over your unit and a meter filling on your HUD, with a rising hiss, well before you freeze: leave the beam's reach, break line of sight, dash, or shoot the freezer.
Frozen, you can't move, fire or use abilities for a short, fixed time (shortest for soldiers, a little longer for vehicles), shown as a crack ring. Hold F, the universal shake-off, to thaw faster.
The ice breaks on the first heavy hit, which does bonus damage; a teammate's heal or repair tool on you also thaws you.
Once thawed you can't be frozen again for a few seconds, which a white outline shows.
teammates: The freezer's team: finishers with heavy single hits (cannons, snipers, a slam) turn freezes into kills, so a freezer and a finisher calling targets to each other are the core combo.
The victim's team: body-block or shield the frozen ally, heal or repair them to thaw them, and hunt the freezer, which can't fight back.
Area freezes are team combos: one player freezes a group and the rest unload on it, the advice the Halo Wars 2 wiki gives for Serina.
Several freezers on one target stack, which rewards a group of cheap cryo units.
controls: Move with WASD and aim with the mouse. Hold left mouse: the cold beam (the unit's primary weapon), with a medium reach; release it and the target's meter drains.
The base pattern needs no extra key. Variants put a cold snap (area freeze), a cold trap or a shatter strike on Q, one counted key within the T2 budget.
Middle mouse, the universal ping, on a frozen target: 'frozen, break it'.
Victim: hold F to thaw faster; it works while frozen and is the stated escape. Teammates thaw you with the main fire of a repair or heal tool.
feedback: Beam: a thick, pale beam, a frost meter ring around the target that everyone can see, and a rising hiss.
Frozen: a large ice block over the model, readable from above, with a crack ring counting down; the frozen player's screen frosts at the edges.
Shatter: a loud crack, flying ice shards, a large damage number and a shatter icon in the kill feed.
Thaw and immunity: the ice melts with a dripping sound, and a white outline marks the immunity window.
A frozen deployable or building shows ice and an 'offline' icon until it thaws.
changes_from_rts: In Red Alert 3 a frozen unit stays frozen until it thaws by itself, and almost any hit destroys it. Against players the freeze must be short and fixed, end on the first heavy hit and be followed by immunity, or one beam takes a player out of the game.
Red Alert 3 measures the freeze against the target's full health, so big targets take longer; keep that, but give soldiers a readable build-up instead of an almost instant freeze.
Red Alert 3 lets tesla, spectrum, radiation and Leech Beam damage skip the shatter bonus; one rule (the first heavy hit shatters) is easier to read.
A frozen flier crashes and dies in Red Alert 3. For a player's aircraft that is too harsh, so it is a high-spice variant at most; by default a frozen flier drifts and loses height, then recovers.
The victim needs stated escapes (break the beam, thaw with F, a teammate's heal, immunity afterwards), or the card carries the 'control without escape' balance flag.
Overwatch 2 took the freeze stun off Mei's primary fire and for a few months in 2023 gave her a slow that her icicle could detonate; the brittle-chill variant offers that softer version at low spice.

team_play.notes: The clearest setup-and-finisher pattern: the freezer can't kill alone and needs a teammate to shatter the target, while the victim's team gets a rescue window (heal, shield, thaw) and a reason to hunt the freezer.

notes: A frost meter per target, with build-up, drain and rates per class, is a simple status system.
The frozen state must stop movement, firing and abilities in every system (seats, deploys, transforms) and end cleanly on a shatter, a thaw or a timeout.
The shatter needs one rule for which hit counts and how the bonus applies, decided by the server so that two players never both get it.
Immunity windows, stacking from several freezers, and frozen buildings or deployables add edge cases.
The meter, the ice and the shatter need strong visuals to read from a top-down camera.
A long or chainable freeze takes control away from a player, the most frustrating thing in a shooter; Overwatch 2 removed the freeze stun from Mei's primary fire.
A freeze plus any hit as an instant kill (the Red Alert 3 rule) makes every freeze a death, so keep the shatter a bonus.
An area freeze followed by area damage can wipe a team in one combo; keep area freezes rare, high-tier and telegraphed.
Several freezers stacking on one target can freeze even a tank almost at once; cap how fast the meter can fill.
The frost meter, the frozen state and the immunity window must be obvious to everyone, the victim's team included.
Players must tell a freeze (brittle, ends on a hit) from a stasis lock (untouchable) and from a stun.
When several beams hit one target, the assist credit needs a clear owner.

variants.name: Cold beam
variants.summary: Hold a beam to fill a target's frost meter: first slowed, then frozen; release it and the meter drains. The basic version.
variants.seen_in: Red Alert 3 Cryocopter and Multigunner IFV with a Cryo Legionnaire; Mei's primary fire in the first Overwatch

variants.name: Brittle chill
variants.summary: The build-up only slows and never freezes; a heavy hit from you or a teammate detonates the chill for bonus damage. The gentle version for low spice.
variants.seen_in: Overwatch 2 Mei's Deep Chill passive (June to October 2023), World of Warcraft's reworked Shatter

adds_strengths.why: Its cold slows a target hard, and a heavy hit on a chilled target detonates the cold for bonus damage.

adds_weaknesses.why: Never stops a target outright: chilled enemies still shoot back, and the bonus waits for a heavy hit to cash it in.

variants.name: Cold snap
variants.summary: On a key, a cold storm, bomb or satellite ray covers an area after a visible warning; enemies who stay inside are slowed and then frozen, so teammates can shatter a whole group.
variants.seen_in: Red Alert 3 Cryoshot protocol, Halo Wars 2 Cryo Bomb, Overwatch Mei's Blizzard

adds_strengths.why: Freezes everyone who stays in the marked area, setting up a whole group for its teammates to shatter.

adds_weaknesses.why: The warning lets enemies step out, the cooldown is long, and the freeze is wasted if no teammate follows up.

variants.name: Shatter strike
variants.summary: A separate finisher, such as a stomp, a slam or a dive, that does little to normal targets but shatters frozen ones for heavy damage. It can sit on the freezer's own card or on a teammate's.
variants.seen_in: Halo Wars 2 Seismic Blast, the Red Alert 3 Cryo Legionnaire's Boost Kick, Destiny 2's shatter slide and dive

adds_strengths.why: Its strike breaks frozen enemies for heavy damage, turning any teammate's freeze into a kill.

adds_weaknesses.why: The strike does little to targets that aren't frozen, so it depends on a freezer working beside it.

variants.name: Cold trap
variants.summary: A hidden mine or a breakable block of ice that freezes whoever touches it, or whoever stands near when it breaks.
variants.seen_in: Halo Wars 2 Cryogenic Generator and Ice Barrier, Destiny 2 Stasis crystals

adds_strengths.why: Freezes the first enemy who trips it while you are elsewhere, ready for a teammate to shatter.

adds_weaknesses.why: Does nothing until someone trips it, and a revealed trap can be avoided or broken from a distance.

variants.name: Stand-still hex
variants.summary: Marks a target with cold that freezes it after a few seconds only if it is still near the spot where the mark landed; moving away breaks it, so the escape is built in.

adds_strengths.why: Forces the marked enemy to run from its spot or be frozen, which breaks up a position or a held angle.

adds_weaknesses.why: Any target that simply walks away escapes the freeze, so it only lands on enemies who are pinned or careless.

variants.name: Shatter threshold
variants.summary: Frostbitten targets can't heal, and any whose health drops below a threshold shatters outright: an execute rather than a hold.

adds_strengths.why: Stops frostbitten enemies from healing and finishes off any that fall low, so wounded targets can't escape to recover.

adds_weaknesses.why: Does nothing to a healthy target by itself, so teammates must bring it low before the threshold matters.

variants.name: Chain shatter
variants.summary: Breaking a frozen target bursts outward, chilling or freezing the enemies around it, so one good freeze can spread through a group.
variants.seen_in: Destiny 2 shatter damage and the Iceflare Bolts aspect

variants.name: Grounded flier
variants.summary: The cold reaches aircraft too, and a frozen flier drops out of the sky and takes heavy damage when it lands.
variants.seen_in: Red Alert 3 Multigunner IFV with a Cryo Legionnaire; frozen aircraft in Red Alert 3 crash

counters.why: Holds heavy tanks and walkers helpless while teammates break them, which no amount of armour prevents.
Freezes artillery before it can fire, shutting down a siege gun before it reaches the defences.
Its cold reaches fliers, which drop out of the sky and take heavy damage when they land.

countered_by.why: Long-range weapons kill the fragile freezer before its short beam completes the build-up.

adds_strengths.why: Its cold beam slows a target and then freezes it for a moment, and the next heavy hit on the frozen target shatters it for bonus damage.

adds_weaknesses.why: The beam does almost no damage: a freeze is wasted unless a teammate follows up, and big targets take a long time to freeze.

counters.why: Holds heavy tanks and walkers helpless while teammates break them, which no amount of armour prevents.
Freezes artillery before it can fire, shutting down a siege gun before it reaches the defences.

countered_by.why: Many freezers can't aim at fliers, and a unit that deals almost no damage can't fight them off anyway.
Long-range weapons kill the fragile freezer before its short beam completes the build-up.

open_questions: How long may a player stay frozen, and how long is the immunity afterwards? This needs playtesting.
Should any damaging hit shatter the ice, or only heavy hits, so that a rifle can't cash in a freeze?
Should frozen aircraft fall, as in Red Alert 3, or only stall and lose height?
Can several freezers stack on one target, and what is the fastest a tank may be frozen?

shooter_fit.reason: A textbook setup-and-finisher combo already proven in Overwatch and Destiny 2, but a hard freeze is the most frustrating control in a shooter, so it fits only short, telegraphed and followed by immunity.
